nodes.name: S1 · They arrive
nodes.notes: From search, a merchant's bio link, our social accounts, or a QR sticker in a real shop.

nodes.name: S2 · They browse the souq
nodes.notes: Featured stores, categories, every store with search. Many merchants in one place is the reason to return.

nodes.name: S3 · They open a store
nodes.notes: That merchant's store, inside our website, carrying our chrome and their brand.

nodes.name: S5 · They add to cart
nodes.notes: Optionally leave a name and WhatsApp number so the merchant can reply.

nodes.name: S6 · They pay the merchant
nodes.notes: Checkout opens WhatsApp to THE MERCHANT. Delivery and payment agreed there. No account, no card on our site.

parameters.content:
## ⚠️ This is a map, not an automation

Every node here is a **No-Op**: it does nothing, sends nothing, and charges nobody. It exists so the business can be read on a canvas instead of in a document.

Press **Execute Workflow** to walk the path — each step lights up in order, and clicking one shows its description.

**Never set these Active.** The workflows that actually run are the numbered ones in the folder above (01–05).

### The shopper never meets the platform

No login, no password, no saved card. They browse, they message a merchant, they pay that merchant.

**What this costs us:** we cannot see their orders, chase abandoned carts, or email them later.

**What it buys us:** no card data, no refunds, no payment licence, and no liability for a sale we were not part of.
